negative_findings.description: Every attempted automated fetch of bank.gov.ua paths (/ua/statistic, /ua/payments/nocash) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden.
negative_findings.result_summary: Four direct WebFetch attempts on bank.gov.ua and data.gov.ua all returned 403 with no body. This is consistent with bot-defence on plain HTTP clients, not with the pages being dead: the same URLs appear constantly in current search results and are cited by third parties. Treated as UNVERIFIED, not dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The single most important publisher in this cell cannot be collected with a naive HTTP client. Any collector must use a browser engine or realistic headers, and liveness verification must not mark these sources dead on a 403.

negative_findings.description: A search result surfaced the hostname new.bank.gov.ua (path /ua/statistic/supervision-statist), suggesting a staging or redesigned NBU site.
negative_findings.result_summary: DNS resolution failed: getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND new.bank.gov.ua. The canonical path on bank.gov.ua carries the same content.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Search indexes may contain stale NBU hostnames; a collector keyed on such a host would silently fail. Pin collection to bank.gov.ua and re-check periodically in case a site migration is actually underway.

negative_findings.description: Could not locate a specific, directly-linked XLSX file for the payment-infrastructure indicators series ('Показники розвитку платіжної інфраструктури') through search alone.

NBU statements confirm machine-readable payment-card data is published, and data.gov.ua exposes XLSX resources for NBU, but the exact bank.gov.ua file URL was not observed and is NOT invented here.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The concrete download URLs must be resolved by rendering /ua/payments/nocash in a browser or by querying the data.gov.ua CKAN API — search-engine discovery is insufficient for NBU's file assets.

negative_findings.description: The NBU financial-inclusion portal appeared under two different hostnames in search results.

negative_findings.why_it_matters: Counting these as independent corroboration would inflate confidence in a single primary series; the collector must deduplicate by underlying release.

negative_findings.description: No Reuters or Bloomberg article specifically on Ukrainian ATM/cash-in-circulation or card statistics surfaced in this pass, despite both wires being known consumers of Interfax-Ukraine copy.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches returned think-tank and niche-outlet coverage instead; global wires appear to cover Ukrainian payments only episodically (sanctions, scheme blockades, macro).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Global wires would be the highest-credibility EN channel; their apparent thinness on payment statistics means the cell must rely on trade press plus NBU primary data.

negative_findings.description: No English-language source found giving Ukraine-specific ATM fleet counts or POS terminal counts as a recurring series; only a one-off wartime figure (~3,800 ATMs, 1,500+ branches) cited via a think tank.
negative_findings.result_summary: ATM/POS infrastructure numbers in English are anecdotal and undated in secondary coverage.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: ATM/POS installed base is a core A4 metric for Printec; the EN media channel cannot supply it and must be served from NBU statistical tables or vendor reports.

negative_findings.description: This cell is scoped to English-language coverage; Ukrainian-language searches were run as required, but their function here was to surface aliases and English-edition equivalents rather than to add uk-language sources (those belong to cell 11).
negative_findings.result_summary: uk query 'Україна платіжний ринок новини англомовні ЗМІ...' surfaced The Paypers, 112.ua/en and GlobalData — i.e. EN assets reachable only via local terms.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms local-language querying materially improves EN-channel recall and should be retained in the collection routine.

negative_findings.description: Several highest-value EN sources are paywalled or licence-restricted: bne IntelliNews premium wire, Interfax full wire, GlobalData and Euromonitor report bodies.
negative_findings.result_summary: Free tiers give headlines and press summaries only.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Budget/licensing decisions are required before these can be used as a data feed rather than a signal detector.

negative_findings.description: No URL in this slice was fetched for liveness; all entries rest on search-result metadata and snippets.
negative_findings.result_summary: URLs are provided with confidence scores only, per the routine's rule that a separate deterministic pass verifies reachability.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents false 'verified' claims; the Kyiv Independent business-section URL in particular is a structural inference.

negative_findings.description: No evidence found of an NBU-run or NBU-sponsored fintech/open-data hackathon in 2025-2026 despite local-language searching.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches on 'хакатон НБУ фінтех' returned the NBU Fintech Strategy 2025 page, open-banking regulation coverage and data.gov.ua datasets, but no hackathon event pages.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Hackathons are a classic venue where API specs and data volumes leak; if none exist in UA, the hackathon sub-layer of this cell is empty and effort should shift to conferences and hiring.

negative_findings.description: LinkedIn company pages and LinkedIn Jobs for Ukrainian banks/PSPs/vendors could not be inspected beyond public search snippets.
negative_findings.result_summary: LinkedIn URLs surfaced repeatedly (UPC, EMA Association) but content is login-gated and LinkedIn ToS prohibits automated collection.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: LinkedIn is the single richest venue for the 'company announcements naming systems and volumes' half of this cell; without access, that channel must be covered manually or via mirrored press releases.

negative_findings.description: Generic search engines do not index individual Ukrainian job postings well; targeted queries returned board landing pages rather than specific vacancies.
negative_findings.result_summary: Queries naming Way4/TranzWare/OpenWay plus Ukraine returned vendor marketing and CVs, not live bank vacancies.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Hiring signals must be collected by querying the boards' own search endpoints directly, not via web search; this shapes the collection design.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Ukrainian payments-industry awards programme was found beyond FinAwards; no separate acquiring/ATM-vendor award was identified.
negative_findings.result_summary: FinAwards (Minfin) is the only recurring award with payment-acceptance categories surfaced in uk-language search.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Award coverage for this cell concentrates in one annual programme, so collection can be narrow but must be timed to Feb-Apr.

negative_findings.description: Automated fetch of https://bank.gov.ua/ua/supervision/payment-services/reg-ps returned HTTP 403 Forbidden. The page is clearly live (it ranks in search and is linked from multiple NBU sections); the 403 is bot protection, not absence.
negative_findings.result_summary: Could not enumerate the exact file names/URLs of the Реєстр платіжної інфраструктури downloads from within this run.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The single most important register in this cell needs a browser-grade collector rather than a plain HTTP fetcher; a naive pipeline would wrongly record bank.gov.ua as unavailable.

negative_findings.description: No published register of authorised open-banking TPPs (AISP/PISP) was located, despite the framework entering into force on 1 August 2025. Searches in both uk and en returned regulatory commentary from law firms but no NBU list URL.
negative_findings.result_summary: Open-banking TPP population is currently undocumented in this cell.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The AISP/PISP list will be the fastest-growing segment of the PSP register; missing it leaves the fintech actor map incomplete.

negative_findings.description: No standalone NBU register specifically of e-money issuers (емітенти електронних грошей) was found as a distinct published list; e-money issuance appears to be handled as a licence type inside the general payment-services authorisation regime under Resolution No. 217.
negative_findings.result_summary: E-money issuers must be extracted as a licence-type filter of a broader register rather than collected from a dedicated list.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Affects collector design: the e-money population is a derived subset, not a separate source.

negative_findings.description: No official register or licence list was found that enumerates ATM or POS terminal deployers/acquirers as such. Registers cover legal persons and their licences, not device estates.
negative_findings.result_summary: ATM/POS device data cannot be obtained from the register layer.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that ATM/POS statistics must come from the NBU statistics workstream, not from registers; registers only supply the acquirer/issuer entity list to join against.

negative_findings.description: ЄДР open data, including ownership structure and ultimate beneficial owners, was suspended from 2022 and only restored in January 2026, with defence-sector entity data still withheld.
negative_findings.result_summary: Beneficial-ownership coverage has a multi-year hole and a residual redaction scope.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any ownership time series for 2022-2025 will be incomplete; historical UBO reconstruction may require commercial aggregators that retained pre-2022 snapshots.

negative_findings.description: Repeated uk-language searching for the size of the Ukrainian cash-in-transit / cash-handling market (обсяг ринку інкасації) returned only vendor service pages and bank tariff pages — no association, regulator or consultancy publishes CIT market volume, revenue or cash-processed tonnage.
negative_findings.result_summary: No public CIT market-size series found; only company self-descriptions and the NBU licence framework.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Cash-logistics cost and capacity is a core input for POS/ATM and cash-automation strategy; absent a market figure, sizing must be reconstructed bottom-up from licensee filings (SMIDA/EDR) and NBU cash-turnover data.

negative_findings.description: No Ukrainian grocery or fuel chain (АТБ, Fozzy/Сільпо, Novus, Varus, Фора, ОККО, WOG) was found publishing its own cash-versus-card payment mix. Coverage discusses acquiring costs and cash-at-till services but never a disclosed cash share by chain.
negative_findings.result_summary: Chain-level cash/card mix is not publicly disclosed in either language.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The demand side of cash usage is invisible at merchant level; the cell must rely on NBU trade-revenue aggregates plus survey proxies, or on paid retail panels.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated, currently published Ukrainian consumer survey specifically on cash-vs-card preference was located from GfK Ukraine, KIIS or Gradus; the GfK payment-habits study surfaced only via a third-party Medium retelling, and academic work (Journal of East-West Business, 2025, n=215) sits behind a Taylor & Francis paywall.
negative_findings.result_summary: Payment-preference survey evidence is fragmentary, second-hand or paywalled.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Consumer cash-preference tracking has no stable free primary series; commissioning or purchasing is likely required for a reliable trend.

negative_findings.description: The NBU electronic register of cash-collection licensees and the NBU cash-turnover statistical table were not resolvable to exact deep links from search results; only the regulation PDF, an English press release and the general statistics landing page were obtained. Not treated as dead — assumed live but unverified.
negative_findings.result_summary: Register and statistics deep-links unpinned; landing pages recorded instead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Automated collection needs stable endpoints; a manual pass on bank.gov.ua is required before scheduling harvesters.

negative_findings.description: Searches combining cash-in-transit, POS terminals and processing in one Ukrainian query returned no single consolidated tender or index; only a specific CIT tender (UA-2021-08-17-006384-a, 'Послуги інкасації та перевезення валютних цінностей') and generic portal pages surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: Composite topic queries do not map to a composite source; the topics must be pursued as separate CPV/keyword streams inside Prozorro.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design should not expect a ready-made 'payments procurement' index; it must be built from CPV plus Ukrainian keyword filters over the raw API.

negative_findings.description: Could not confirm via search that Prozorro Market's e-catalogue actually carries CPV 30123600 (cash dispensers / автомати для видачі готівки) or payment-terminal product cards.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only general Prozorro Market documentation was returned; no product-level evidence for ATM or POS categories.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The e-catalogue's usefulness for hardware price benchmarking is a hypothesis until a human checks the CPV tree on the platform itself.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated TED view or filter specifically indexing Ukraine-directed payment/banking-equipment tenders was found via search; only a generic Denmark/EUACI IT-equipment framework example surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: TED coverage of Ukraine payment hardware must be established by running CPV plus country filters directly on TED, not from a pre-existing index.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets expectations: TED is a low-yield but high-credibility stream for this cell, requiring its own query engineering.

negative_findings.description: No Ukrainian-language donor-procurement aggregator was found that consolidates EBRD/UNDP/World Bank Ukraine notices; donor procurement appears only in English-language portals.
negative_findings.result_summary: Ukrainian-language search terms for donor procurement returned domestic Prozorro platforms rather than donor indexes.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Donor-funded stream must be collected in English; local-language monitoring will systematically miss it.

negative_findings.description: Clarity Project restricted free access to extended Prozorro analytics (reported January 2024); subscription pricing reported roughly UAH 450/day to UAH 33,000/year.
negative_findings.result_summary: Deep supplier/competitor analytics on this platform now carries a cost; the free tier is limited.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Budget and licensing must be planned if Clarity is to be part of the standing collection stack; otherwise fall back to the free Prozorro API plus BI module.

negative_findings.description: Ukrainian banks, including the systemically important ones, do not maintain equity-style investor relations sites with quarterly investor presentations or fact books. Searches for 'investor presentation' and 'інвестиційна презентація' for PrivatBank/Oschadbank/Raiffeisen Ukraine returned no bank-published IR decks.
negative_findings.result_summary: No bank-hosted IR presentation decks found; disclosure is limited to statutory IFRS statements, an integrated annual report (PrivatBank), press releases, and the Ministry of Finance's state-bank decks.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must target annual reports, press centres and MoF decks rather than an IR calendar; there is no quarterly deck cadence to schedule against.

negative_findings.description: Beyond PrivatBank and monobank, banks generally do not publish absolute card-issued, ATM and POS-estate counts in their statutory reporting. Searches for Ukrsibbank, OTP, Kredobank and Pivdenny surfaced product/locator pages but no published estate statistics.
negative_findings.result_summary: Per-bank card/ATM/POS counts are sparse outside the two largest card players; mid-tier banks reveal estate only implicitly via locator maps.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Bank-level ATM/POS market sizing will have to be reconstructed from locator scrapes and NBU aggregates rather than from disclosure documents.

negative_findings.description: The legacy Raiffeisen Aval reporting archive at ex.aval.ua returned a 'Request Rejected' interstitial in search results.
negative_findings.result_summary: Treated as bot-defended-but-live, not dead; unverified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Historical card/ATM series for Aval may need archive.org retrieval or header-adjusted fetching.

negative_findings.description: The Sense Bank corporate domain (sensebank.ua) and the Oschadbank reporting subsection were inferred from context rather than confirmed by fetch during this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: URLs supplied with reduced confidence; liveness left to the deterministic verification pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Two systemically important banks' primary disclosure paths remain to be pinned down precisely.

negative_findings.description: No Ukraine-specific customer case study was located on the global sites of NCR Atleos or Diebold Nixdorf despite targeted en-language searching.
negative_findings.result_summary: OEM case-study libraries surfaced CEE examples (e.g. Turkey) but nothing named for Ukraine; Ukrainian OEM presence appears to be mediated entirely through local partners/distributors rather than direct OEM reference marketing.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The installed-base route for global ATM OEMs in Ukraine must be worked through local partners and bank press releases, not OEM marketing — this changes the collection plan for the ATM hardware segment.

negative_findings.description: The uk-language query for Ingenico/PAX/Verifone official distributors in Ukraine returned almost exclusively North American resellers.
negative_findings.result_summary: No Ukrainian authorised-distributor page for the major POS terminal OEMs was identified this run; the only Ukraine-anchored terminal-vendor signals came indirectly via PRRO software certification (Checkbox/Printec, Castles S1F2) and bank acquiring pages.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: POS terminal brand share in Ukraine is currently unobservable from OEM channel pages; the fiscalisation-certification route is the working substitute and should be prioritised.

negative_findings.description: No settled Ukrainian-language term set was found for switch and HSM procurement (payment switch, hardware security module, key management).
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches returned English product terminology only; Ukrainian bank/vendor material appears to use the English terms untranslated, and no Ukraine-specific HSM integrator page was found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The switch/HSM sub-segment of this cell is currently uncovered in local language; future runs should search transliterations and English-in-Ukrainian forms rather than attempted translations.

negative_findings.description: "Сістем Груп Україна" and "БМС Консалтинг" were probed as suspected bank-IT integrators but neither was confirmed with a bank-facing reference page in this run.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches surfaced no corroborating vendor page tying either name to Ukrainian bank projects; they remain unverified actor-map hypotheses, not sources.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a fabricated integrator entry and flags two names for targeted re-checking against event sponsor lists and registry data.

negative_findings.description: No Ukrainian acquirer, PSP or processor publishes an industry-wide acquiring aggregate (total acquiring turnover, total active merchants, total POS estate). Searches in Ukrainian for 'еквайринг Україна обсяг транзакцій кількість торговців' returned only product/tariff pages and single-firm claims.
negative_findings.result_summary: Operator-side data exists only as scattered self-reported KPIs; the only market-wide aggregation is regulator-side (NBU), which sits outside this cell.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell must be collected firm-by-firm and reconciled; any market total built from operator disclosures will be a bottom-up estimate with double-counting risk (bank acquirer vs PSP-on-top-of-acquirer).

negative_findings.description: IBOX (IBOX Bank / IBOX terminal network) produced no usable volume or terminal-count disclosure in the Ukrainian-language operator search; results returned nothing for this name.
negative_findings.result_summary: Zero hits for IBOX volume data in the uk-language query that surfaced NovaPay, EasyPay and iPay.ua figures.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: IBOX Bank's 2023 licence revocation likely removed its disclosures from circulation; the cash-in terminal segment therefore has a hole where a formerly large operator sat, and successor operators need separate identification.

negative_findings.description: Merchant counts and throughput figures for the strongest domestic e-commerce acquirers (RozetkaPay ~28k-35k merchants, ~350k operations/day; Solidgate ~350 clients, ~50% YoY growth) exist only as marketing claims or interview statements, with no audited or regulator-filed counterpart located.
negative_findings.result_summary: Numbers are real and citable but unverifiable and inconsistently defined across firms and dates.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any trend series built from these must be flagged as self-reported; definitional drift (merchants vs contracts vs entrepreneurs) will otherwise create false growth.

negative_findings.description: No standalone Ukrainian BNPL operator with public volume disclosure was found; BNPL in Ukraine is delivered as a bank credit product (PUMB «Сплата частинами», PrivatBank «Оплата частинами», monobank «покупка частинами») and only qualitative uplift claims (~+30% purchase frequency) surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: BNPL market size for Ukraine is not published by providers in either language.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: BNPL cannot be sized from operator disclosures in this run; it must be inferred from bank consumer-lending reporting instead.

negative_findings.description: No established Ukrainian-language term or operator brand was located for a domestic instant/QR account-to-account payment scheme run by a private provider; the searches surfaced only card-scheme tokenisation and bank apps, with instant payments framed as an NBU/regulator initiative.
negative_findings.result_summary: Local-language coverage of the QR/instant-payments sub-segment of this cell is effectively empty at the operator level.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell brief explicitly names QR/instant-payment providers; this sub-segment may not yet exist commercially in Ukraine, which is itself a finding, but it needs a dedicated follow-up with NBU instant-payment-system participant terminology.

negative_findings.description: The one English-language source promising systematic acquiring transaction value/volume series (GlobalData 'Ukraine Cards and Payments') is a paid commercial report; only the abstract is accessible.
negative_findings.result_summary: Headline framing accessible, underlying series not.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Budget decision required if a validated market-level series is needed; otherwise the run must rely on NBU plus bottom-up operator aggregation.

negative_findings.description: Neither Visa nor Mastercard appears to publish a Ukraine-specific quantitative dataset (transaction counts, volumes, acceptance-point counts) — only narrative press releases built on commissioned consumer surveys with small samples (e.g. n=679 online shoppers in Kyiv and Kharkiv).
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in uk and en surfaced only survey-based press releases and no downloadable Ukraine data file from either scheme.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Scheme-level quantitative market share for Ukraine must be sourced from the NBU card-market statistics, not from the schemes themselves; scheme releases should be treated as sentiment/behaviour indicators with weak sampling.

negative_findings.description: No Ukrainian-language UnionPay country press room or ua-locale site was found; UnionPay Ukraine material exists only in English on unionpayintl.com and is dated 2018-2020.
negative_findings.result_summary: English queries returned company news and market updates; a targeted Ukrainian-language UnionPay corporate channel could not be identified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: UnionPay's Ukrainian footprint is likely dormant or wound down; treat its acceptance/ATM figures as historical baselines, not current, and do not expect ongoing local-language disclosure.

negative_findings.description: No Ukraine-specific SWIFT country page or SWIFT-published Ukraine statistics series was identified within this cell's searches; Ukrainian cross-border messaging context surfaces instead through NBU SEP/SEPA-alignment material.
negative_findings.result_summary: Queries on SWIFT/SEPA/instant payments returned NBU pages and third-party fintech blogs, not a SWIFT primary source scoped to Ukraine.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Cross-border rail intelligence for Ukraine should be anchored on NBU SEP/IPS publications and EU/SEPA (EPC) decisions rather than on an assumed SWIFT country disclosure.

negative_findings.description: Both scheme interchange disclosures are date-stamped or CDN-path PDFs (Mastercard's filename embeds 26-11-2021); the current editions may sit at URLs not discoverable by search.
negative_findings.result_summary: Found one Visa IRF PDF and one dated Mastercard Ukraine PDF; no stable index page listing all editions was located.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection must discover the parent directory/landing page rather than hard-coding a PDF URL, or the tracker will silently freeze on a stale rate table.

negative_findings.description: Base URLs for nabu.ua, amcu.gov.ua and the Rada bill-card path were inferred from actor identity rather than retrieved from search results, and no fetch was attempted.
negative_findings.result_summary: Actors confirmed by name in coverage; canonical entry URLs not directly observed in results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These three entries need the deterministic liveness pass to confirm the entry points before any collector is pointed at them.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Ukrainian ATM-deployer or cash-in-transit (інкасація) industry association was found. Searches in Ukrainian for інкасація/перевезення цінностей/банкомати asociation terms returned only individual CIT service companies (cit.net.ua, cit-security.ua), the Wikipedia article on інкасація, and NBU cash-handling regulations.
negative_findings.result_summary: Domestic ATM/CIT self-regulation appears to run through NABU/AUB working groups and the NBU rather than a standalone trade body; ATMIA Europe is the nearest substitute.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The ATM/cash-logistics segment — core to the ATM POS data and cash usage topics — has no association-level survey source in Ukraine, so those metrics must come from the regulator, vendors, or bank disclosures instead of cell #8.

negative_findings.description: No single authoritative Ukrainian e-commerce association with published online-payment statistics was located. Searches surfaced 'Ukrainian E-Commerce Expert' (described as a communication platform, LinkedIn presence only), Ukrainian E-Commerce Awards, and event brands (Ukrainian eCommerce Day, organised by the fintech association UAFIC) rather than a member-based association publishing market data.
negative_findings.result_summary: E-commerce payment statistics appear to be produced by RAU, UAFIC, the shopping-centre council and commercial platforms rather than by an e-commerce trade association.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents over-investing crawler effort hunting for a non-existent 'Ukrainian E-commerce Association' data feed; redirects e-commerce payment coverage to RAU/UAFIC/UCSC.

negative_findings.description: https://nabu.ua/ua/karta-sayta.html returned HTTP 429 Too Many Requests, and https://fintechua.org/ returned an essentially empty document body (client-side rendered).
negative_findings.result_summary: Neither is evidence the sites are dead; both are hypotheses of rate-limiting and JS-rendering respectively.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design for these two high-priority sources must budget for polite pacing (NABU) and headless rendering (UAFIC); a naive crawler would misclassify them as unavailable.

negative_findings.description: NABU appears under two Ukrainian names — 'Незалежна асоціація банків України' (historic, founded 2011) and 'Національна асоціація банків України' (current usage), sharing the domain nabu.ua and USREOU code 37924657. Separately, the acronym НАБУ collides with the National Anti-Corruption Bureau of Ukraine.
negative_findings.result_summary: One legal entity, two names in circulation, plus a high-noise acronym collision.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Query design must disambiguate: pair НАБУ with 'банків'/'банківськ' terms or use nabu.ua site-restricted search, otherwise anti-corruption-bureau results will dominate and dedup logic may split one actor into two.

negative_findings.description: The Ukrainian Credit-Banking Union surfaced on two domains, kbs.org.ua and ukbs.org.ua, without a clear indication of which is canonical or current.
negative_findings.result_summary: Canonical domain unresolved in this pass; neither was fetched.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Requires manual resolution before scheduling collection, and the union's activity level (last publication date) should be checked before treating it as a live source.

negative_findings.description: The Всеукраїнська асоціація фінансових компаній (ВАФК) has a Facebook page and corporate-registry cards (opendatabot, youcontrol, vkursi) but no independent website was located in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Non-bank financial companies' association is visible as a legal entity but not as a publisher.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Non-bank payment institutions are the fastest-growing licence category; if their association does not publish, that segment's association-level intelligence must be sourced from NBU registers and individual firms instead.

negative_findings.description: Searched specifically for a dedicated Ukraine POS terminal / ATM market report from Mordor Intelligence and IMARC. Mordor has country-level POS reports for Cyprus, Croatia and a Europe-wide report, but no Ukraine-specific POS or ATM report surfaced; no IMARC Ukraine payments report surfaced either.
negative_findings.result_summary: No standalone commercial Ukraine ATM/POS hardware market report identified in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: ATM/POS installed-base and vendor-share data for Ukraine will likely have to come from NBU statistics, acquirer disclosures and regional (Europe/CEE) commercial reports rather than a Ukraine-specific bought report.

negative_findings.description: Deloitte's 'Overview of Ukraine's banking sector 2023-2024' is cited in Ukrainian academic literature as a 38-page Kyiv publication, but a direct search of deloitte.com/ua did not surface the report's landing page or PDF URL.
negative_findings.result_summary: Report existence is well-attested via citation; canonical URL unresolved.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This is likely the single most valuable free Big Four sector deliverable for the cell; a verification pass should crawl the Deloitte Ukraine insights index directly rather than relying on search engines.

negative_findings.description: Ukrainian-language searching produced almost no results for commercial *paid* payments-market reports written in Ukrainian; uk-language queries returned academic journal articles (economyandsociety.in.ua, nayka.com.ua), consultancy insight hubs and rating agencies instead.
negative_findings.result_summary: The paid Ukraine payments-report market appears to be transacted almost entirely in English by foreign publishers; Ukrainian-language commercial research is concentrated in survey houses, rating agencies and Big Four local offices.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Shapes collection design: for uk-language commercial intelligence, target rating agencies, survey houses and press-release wires, not report storefronts.

negative_findings.description: No Ukraine-focused specialist payments-market research boutique (an equivalent of a regional payments consultancy publishing recurring UA card/acquiring market reports) was identified. Coverage is split between global publishers, Big Four locals, rating agencies and generalist survey houses.
negative_findings.result_summary: No dedicated Ukrainian payments-research house found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms there is no single commercial substitute for NBU primary statistics; aggregation must be assembled across several actor types.

negative_findings.description: RA Rurik's quarterly 'Аналітичний огляд банківської системи України' PDF series was only surfaced in an old edition (Q4 2014); whether the series continues post-2022 is unknown.
negative_findings.result_summary: Series may be discontinued; treat as unverified rather than dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If still live it is a free, structured, system-level quarterly aggregate; if dead the effort should shift to Standard-Rating's diagnostic studies.

negative_findings.description: No BIS CPMI Red Book / CPMI statistics coverage of Ukraine was found. Ukraine is not a CPMI member jurisdiction, so BIS comparative payment statistics (cards, POS, ATM per capita) appear not to include UA.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches surfaced no BIS statistical table containing Ukraine payment-system data; BIS coverage seems limited to member jurisdictions.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Analysts expecting a BIS benchmark for Ukraine must fall back on IMF FAS and World Bank GPSS/Findex; a BIS citation for UA would likely be a misattribution.

negative_findings.description: ECB payments statistics (Payments Statistics / SDW-ECB Data Portal) cover EU/EEA reporting agents; Ukraine is not a reporting country, so no ECB-published UA card/POS series was identified.
negative_findings.result_summary: No Ukraine series located in ECB comparative payments statistics during this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: ECB data is still useful as an EU peer benchmark for Ukraine's convergence narrative, but cannot supply Ukrainian figures themselves.

negative_findings.description: The EBRD Project Summary Documents listing for Ukraine is a JavaScript filter interface; a stable machine-readable endpoint for the filtered project list was not confirmed in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: URL with filterCountry=Ukraine identified but not proven to return server-rendered rows.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Automated harvesting of EBRD Ukraine project disclosures may need a headless browser or an undocumented JSON API; this should be tested before relying on it.

negative_findings.description: USAID Ukraine financial-sector programme materials are largely mirrored on NBU pages; USAID's own document repository (DEC) and programme sites were not directly confirmed reachable in this pass, and USAID restructuring since 2025 raises the risk of link rot for programme archives.
negative_findings.result_summary: Programme content found chiefly via bank.gov.ua rather than usaid.gov/dec.usaid.gov.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Historical POS/acceptance statistics published by USAID projects may vanish; mirrors and early archiving are advisable.

negative_findings.description: No Ukrainian-language version of the World Bank Global Findex or IMF FAS Ukraine data tables was found; these datasets appear to be English-only.
negative_findings.result_summary: uk-language searches returned academic and government commentary about financial inclusion, not localised IFI datasets.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Ukrainian-language monitoring must target NBU/MoF republications and academic secondary sources rather than the IFI datasets themselves.

coverage_gaps.description: Section-level URLs are well identified but the concrete recurring dataset files (XLSX/CSV) for cards, ATMs and POS terminals are not pinned down to exact URLs.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run one browser-rendered pass over https://bank.gov.ua/ua/payments/nocash and https://bank.gov.ua/ua/statistic/supervision-statist, capture all /admin_uploads/ and /files/ asset links, and register each recurring file as its own source with its naming pattern.

coverage_gaps.description: The NBUStatService OpenData API is confirmed to exist with directory and statistical-reporting endpoints, but the actual list of open-data blocks (and whether any covers card/ATM/POS series rather than only FX and reporting dimensions) was not enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Read Technical_instructions_f_REST_API_OpenData.pdf and Technical_instructions_stat_zvit_REST_API_OpenData.pdf, then call the root /statdirectory endpoint and inventory every data block; flag whether payment-infrastructure series are API-available or file-only.

coverage_gaps.description: No NBU statistical release calendar was located, so publication timing for card/terminal and cash series is inferred from observed cadence rather than documented.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Look for the NBU 'графік оприлюднення статистичних даних' / statistics release calendar page during the browser pass and register it as a scheduling source.

coverage_gaps.description: Stable-URL publications (notably https://bank.gov.ua/files/stat.pdf) overwrite in place, and NBU has issued revised card-market figures, so historical and revision coverage is not guaranteed by URL harvesting alone.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Version and hash every downloaded file locally; add a web-archive fallback for back-issues and record revision events explicitly.

coverage_gaps.description: The NBU maintains parallel uk and en editions, but whether the en edition lags or omits annexes was not tested.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For two or three release cycles, collect both /ua/ and /en/ variants of the same release and measure lag and content delta; then decide which edition is the source of record (default: uk).

coverage_gaps.description: Published aggregates give national totals; bank-level or acquirer-level ATM/POS breakdowns were not found in public releases.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Check the Register of Statistical Reporting Indicators to identify which reporting forms carry terminal/acquiring detail, then assess whether an access-to-public-information request (запит на публічну інформацію) to the NBU is a viable route.

coverage_gaps.description: Регіональні головні управління статистики (oblast statistics offices, e.g. cv./od./mk./kyiv.ukrstat.gov.ua) republish and sometimes extend household and retail-trade tables, but were only sampled, not enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the full set of oblast statistics-office subdomains and test which publish sub-national household expenditure and retail turnover tables usable for regional payment-adoption modelling.

coverage_gaps.description: Other non-NBU public bodies plausibly holding payment-relevant data were not searched in this pass: Держаудитслужба, Рахункова палата (audit of state banks and of cashless programmes), НКЦПФР, Держфінмоніторинг (cash transaction thresholds), and Укрпошта as a cash-distribution and payment agent in rural areas.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a second sweep on these actors with Ukrainian-language queries, especially Рахункова палата audit reports on state banks and Держфінмоніторинг typology reports on cash.

coverage_gaps.description: Public procurement (ProZorro / prozorro.gov.ua and its analytics layer bi.prozorro.org) was not searched, although it is the richest open channel for ATM and POS terminal tenders, quantities, models and prices.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Dedicated pass on ProZorro with CPV codes and Ukrainian terms (банкомат, платіжний термінал, POS-термінал, еквайринг) plus its BI/API endpoints.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language coverage of this cell is thin because these bodies publish primarily in Ukrainian; only the EU portal profile and the Держстат API page were found in English. No English-term equivalents were identified for РРО/ПРРО fiscalisation concepts, which have no clean English analogue.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Treat Ukrainian as the primary collection language for cell 02; maintain a uk-en term map (РРО/ПРРО ≈ fiscal cash register, еквайринг ≈ acquiring, безготівкові розрахунки ≈ cashless settlements) for downstream analysis.

coverage_gaps.description: Several search terms are noisy and degrade automated discovery: 'кешбек' overwhelmingly returns the National Cashback consumer programme rather than payment-market analysis; 'index.minfin.com.ua' is a private site easily mistaken for the Ministry of Finance; 'data.gov' searches in English drift to the US portal.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Constrain automated queries with site: filters on gov.ua domains and pair ambiguous terms with disambiguators (АМКУ, Держстат, ринок, дослідження).

coverage_gaps.description: No regional or second-tier-bank-focused Ukrainian trade media were identified in this pass; all candidates are Kyiv-centric national outlets covering the large banks (PrivatBank, PUMB, Sense, Oschad) and national PSPs.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run targeted uk searches per oblast and per second-tier bank name (e.g. банк + область + банкомати/термінали) and check regional business portals and oblast press for bank-branch/ATM network stories.

coverage_gaps.description: Only text media were assessed. Ukrainian fintech/banking podcasts, YouTube channels and conference video (including EMA and trade-outlet events) were not searched, yet executives often give the most specific unpublished numbers on stage or on camera.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a dedicated pass over YouTube/podcast feeds of psm7, Fintech Insider, Banker.ua, Mind and EMA event recordings; plan transcript-based collection.

coverage_gaps.description: Paywall/subscription status was only verified for Fintech Insider and Finclub; Forbes Ukraine, Mind.ua, NV and Interfax paywall tiers are assumed, not tested.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Have the deterministic verification pass record HTTP status, paywall markers and robots.txt for every candidate before designing collection.

coverage_gaps.description: PSP/acquirer-side trade coverage is thinner than bank-side: NovaPay, iPay.ua, Portmone, LiqPay, Fondy, EasyPay and Concord-successor acquirers were only touched incidentally, and no PSP-specialist outlet was located.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Snowball each named PSP through the EMA member list and each outlet's tag pages to build a per-actor interview inventory.

coverage_gaps.description: No global newswire (Reuters, Bloomberg, AP, AFP, Dow Jones) confirmed as a tracked Ukraine payments channel in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run targeted site-scoped searches on reuters.com/bloomberg.com for 'Ukraine' + NBU/hryvnia cash/card, and evaluate a licensed wire feed with a Ukraine+payments keyword profile.

coverage_gaps.description: Sanctions-and-payments coverage (scheme blockades, correspondent banking, cross-border restrictions affecting Ukraine) is represented only by a 2022 Finextra item.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add sanctions-specialist EN sources (OFAC/EU press, law-firm sanctions alerts, ACAMS/Global Investigations Review) to the cell and re-query for 2024-2026 developments.

coverage_gaps.description: Processing/acquiring and ATM-service vendors operating in Ukraine (e.g. Ukrainian Processing Center, acquirers, ATM deployers) have no confirmed recurring EN news channel.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Map vendor corporate newsrooms and LinkedIn/press pages directly; snowball from UPC and from NBU's registers of payment infrastructure service providers.

coverage_gaps.description: EN coverage is Kyiv-centric; regional cash-access dynamics (frontline oblasts, de-occupied territories, POWER BANKING sites) are covered only anecdotally.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Track humanitarian/IFI reporting (World Bank, EBRD, IFC, UNDP, IOM cash-transfer programmes) which publishes in EN on regional cash access.

coverage_gaps.description: Pre-2022 English baseline coverage now sits largely in archive.kyivpost.com and defunct feeds, risking loss of the pre-war comparison series.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Snapshot archive.kyivpost.com Interfax-Ukraine author pages and relevant Wayback captures early in the collection programme.

coverage_gaps.description: LinkedIn company-post and LinkedIn Jobs layer is unaddressed due to login gating and ToS.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Cover manually via a human analyst account, or substitute by monitoring company newsrooms, Facebook pages (EMA, banks) and psm7/Minfin reprints of the same announcements.

coverage_gaps.description: Careers pages of several relevant actors were not individually located in this pass: Oschadbank, Raiffeisen Bank Ukraine, monobank/Universal Bank, Sense Bank, A-Bank, TAScombank, plus terminal/ATM vendors and integrators operating in UA (NCR Atleos, Diebold Nixdorf, Ingenico/PAX distributors, Printec-type integrators).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run one targeted pass per actor: '<bank name> вакансії карткові продукти / еквайринг / банкомати' and capture the careers URL into the source register.

coverage_gaps.description: Conference agendas and speaker lists are ephemeral — organiser sites typically replace the previous edition's programme.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Snapshot agenda/speaker pages at event time each year and register Wayback Machine captures for EMA, Pay.Forum, DigitalForum FPF and Power Payment Summit.

coverage_gaps.description: Conference presentation decks and video recordings — where the actual volume figures appear — were not located; only programmes and journalistic recaps were found.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Check EMA member area, organiser YouTube channels and speaker SlideShare/LinkedIn posts for deck availability; assess membership cost for EMA if decks are member-only.

coverage_gaps.description: Resume databases carry the strongest system-level disclosures but contain personal data.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Define a strict handling rule: extract only employer + system/technology + year, never store names or contact details; document this in the collection policy before any resume-derived collection begins.

coverage_gaps.description: Exact download URLs for the Реєстр платіжної інфраструктури, the non-bank registers search results, and the kis.bank.gov.ua backend were not obtained because bank.gov.ua rejects automated fetches.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a browser-based (headless Chrome / Playwright) pass over bank.gov.ua register pages, capture network XHR calls, and record the resulting file and JSON endpoints.

coverage_gaps.description: Registers of currency-exchange operators, and any register of collection/cash-handling (інкасація) operators relevant to cash usage, were only partially touched via the legacy old.bank.gov.ua directory.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search specifically for «реєстр небанківських установ, що мають ліцензію на здійснення валютних операцій» and «оператори з інкасації» and resolve their current NBU pages.

coverage_gaps.description: No systematic archive strategy identified for NBU register snapshots (only the DGF publishes a dated archive of its member list).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Set up periodic self-snapshotting of NBU register downloads and back-fill from web.archive.org for bank.gov.ua and old.bank.gov.ua register pages.

coverage_gaps.description: Cross-register joining (NBU licence lists vs ЄДР vs DGF vs aggregators) depends on consistent EDRPOU and MFO keys, which was not validated in this run.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Validate that each register exposes EDRPOU (and MFO for banks) and design a canonical entity table before bulk collection.

coverage_gaps.description: Terms of use / API licensing for the commercial aggregators (YouControl, Opendatabot, Clarity Project) were not read in this run, so collection_allowed for them is a provisional assessment.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Review each platform's ToS and API pricing before any automated collection; prefer official open data where equivalent.

coverage_gaps.description: Only 3 of the ~9 NBU-licensed CIT operators were identified with a live web presence (CIT Security, Інкас Сервіс/cit.net.ua, Cash and Security). Українська сервісна інкасація, Перша інкасаторська компанія, О-МЕГА, Панорама Прикарпаття, Діамант Секʼюриті and Комсервіс-Безпека have no captured URLs.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Resolve each licensee via the NBU register plus YouControl/Opendatabot/EDR by EDRPOU, then pull SMIDA/EDR financials to bottom-up size the CIT market.

coverage_gaps.description: Utility/biller side of cash bill payment is under-covered: regional oblenergo, gas (Нафтогаз/газозбут), water and heating utilities publish payment-collection (рівень розрахунків / оплата населення) statistics that implicitly reveal cash channel shares, and none were scouted in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout oblenergo/teplokomunenergo and Naftogaz reporting for 'рівень оплати населення' and payment-channel breakdowns; add the НКРЕКП regulator portal as a pointer.

coverage_gaps.description: Fuel networks (ОККО, WOG, Socar, БРСМ) and their cash mix, plus NovaPay/Нова пошта counter-based cash payments — a fast-growing non-bank cash acceptance channel — were not covered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add NovaPay and Nova Poshta reporting plus fuel-retail issuer filings and trade press (enkorr.ua) to the next scouting pass.

coverage_gaps.description: No source found that disaggregates cash usage by oblast or by frontline/de-occupied vs. rear regions, despite wartime cash demand being highly regional (power outages, damaged infrastructure, migration cited in Ukrposhta's own report).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Test whether NBU regional cash-turnover breakdowns or Ukrposhta branch-level data exist; consider FOI (запит на публічну інформацію) to NBU and Ukrposhta.

coverage_gaps.description: Open-data and registry routes (data.gov.ua, Prozorro procurement of інкасація services by state bodies/banks, Opendatabot/YouControl) were not exercised; Prozorro tenders in particular would expose contracted cash-collection prices and volumes.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run Prozorro keyword searches for 'послуги з інкасації' and 'перевезення грошових цінностей' and add data.gov.ua datasets as candidates.

coverage_gaps.description: No verified CPV code list for ATM, POS/payment terminal, self-service kiosk, cash-processing and card-processing procurement in the Ukrainian classifier (ДК 021:2015).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build and validate a CPV crosswalk (candidate roots: 30123600 cash dispensers, 30142000 accounting/cash machines, 302xxxxx office/computing equipment, 48xxxxxx software, 66xxxxxx financial services, 79710000 security/CIT) against actual Prozorro tender data before running production filters.

coverage_gaps.description: Private commercial banks and non-bank PSPs (e.g. Raiffeisen, Universal/monobank, FUIB, PUMB, OTP, and independent ATM/terminal operators) are not subject to Prozorro and are largely absent from this cell's sources.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend into the commercial-tender sections of accredited marketplaces and into vendor-side announcements; flag the private-bank fleet as a blind spot to be covered by other cells (regulatory/NBU statistics, vendor press).

coverage_gaps.description: Contract-level documents (tender documentation, technical specifications, award protocols, signed contracts as attachments) were not individually assessed — only the portals that host them.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pilot a document-harvest pass on 10-20 known ATM/CIT tenders to establish attachment formats, OCR needs and how often unit counts and prices are actually disclosed.

coverage_gaps.description: World Bank (UN Development Business / STEP), USAID and EU delegation procurement for Ukraine were not searched in this slice; only EBRD, UNDP/UNGM and TED were covered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a second donor sweep covering World Bank procurement notices, USAID/Grants.gov and EU funding-and-tenders portal filtered on Ukraine financial-sector projects.

coverage_gaps.description: Several URLs (bipro.prozorro.org, dasu.gov.ua, prozorro.gov.ua/ProzorroMarket, tender.privatbank.ua) were recorded from search results and reasoning rather than fetched; access status and exact paths are unverified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Let the deterministic liveness pass confirm; re-derive canonical URLs for any that redirect or 404.

coverage_gaps.description: Smaller and niche banks (Банк Кредит Дніпро, ТАСкомбанк, Банк Восток, Правекс, Ідея Банк, Банк Львів, Юнекс, MTB, Полтава-банк) were not individually scouted; several are active card issuers or acquirer-adjacent.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the NBU register of operating banks, then resolve each bank's site to its звітність and новини paths programmatically; use SMIDA XML as the fallback for banks without usable sites.

coverage_gaps.description: Branch/ATM locator endpoints were identified conceptually (Kredobank, Pivdenny) but the underlying JSON/XHR feeds were not enumerated for any bank.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For the top 15 banks, inspect the locator page network traffic, document the device-list endpoint, and set up periodic snapshots to build a longitudinal ATM/POS estate census.

coverage_gaps.description: Foreign parent-group disclosures (RBI, BNP Paribas, OTP Group, Crédit Agricole, PKO BP for Kredobank) that carry Ukraine segment data were not scouted in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a sweep of parent-group annual/quarterly segment reporting and investor decks for Ukraine-specific client, card and digital-channel metrics — often more granular than the local subsidiary's disclosure.

coverage_gaps.description: Interim (quarterly/half-year) bank reporting cadence and publication dates were not mapped, only annual artefacts.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Document each bank's statutory publication deadlines (NBU/NSSMC) to schedule collection rather than polling blindly.

coverage_gaps.description: POS terminal hardware OEM/distributor layer in Ukraine (Ingenico, PAX, Verifone, Castles, NEXGO channel partners) has no identified authoritative source.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Work backwards from acquirer bank equipment pages (PrivatBank, Sense Bank, PUMB, Raiffeisen) and from PRRO certification lists (Checkbox, Vchasno.Kasa, Cashalot) which name approved terminal models and their suppliers; also check DSTU/fiscal-device state registers.

coverage_gaps.description: Payment switch and HSM/key-management vendors and their Ukrainian integrators are not represented among candidates.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search transliterated and English-in-Ukrainian terms (HSM, свіч, криптомодуль, Thales, Utimaco, Futurex) plus PCI DSS QSA/assessor listings for Ukraine, and check NBU cybersecurity/PCI requirement documents for named technologies.

coverage_gaps.description: Quantitative vendor revenue and customer-concentration data sits behind registry-aggregator paywalls (YouControl, Opendatabot) rather than on free pages.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Budget for one registry-aggregator subscription or API key, or build against the underlying state open-data registers (EDR, SMIDA, tax open data) directly to avoid ToS issues.

coverage_gaps.description: Vendor win announcements are frequently published only on LinkedIn or in conference materials rather than on corporate sites, and neither was systematically searched this run.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a LinkedIn company-page monitoring pass for the confirmed vendor list, and harvest sponsor/agenda PDFs from the Banking IT Summit and Ukrainian fintech events for the last 3 years.

coverage_gaps.description: Several key references found are dated (Printec Ukraine 2019 management report, older AUB/Alfa-Bank processing-migration articles); current-year vendor activity is thinly covered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a date-restricted (2024-2026) sweep over each confirmed vendor domain and over psm7.com/PaySpace, NABU and AUB newsfeeds to build a recent migration and deployment timeline.

coverage_gaps.description: E-money issuers (емітенти електронних грошей) and licensed wallet providers were not enumerated individually — only the NBU register that contains them was located. No named Ukrainian e-money/wallet operator with public volume data was captured this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pull the NBU Payment Infrastructure Register e-money-issuer section, extract every licensed EMI, and run a per-firm uk-language disclosure search on each name.

coverage_gaps.description: QR and instant account-to-account payment providers are uncovered at the operator level; no commercial provider was identified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search NBU instant-payment-system (СЕП/instant payments) participant lists and terms such as 'миттєві платежі', 'оплата за QR-кодом', 'платіжна ініціація', 'відкритий банкінг PIS' to find operator-level actors.

coverage_gaps.description: POS terminal estate and ATM fleet numbers were not obtained from any operator — only qualitative mobile-acquiring/SoftPOS narrative from Oschadbank and processing-scale claims from UPC.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Target acquirer annual reports and ATM-network operators (including independent ATM deployers) with terms 'кількість POS-терміналів', 'термінальна мережа', 'банкоматна мережа'; combine with UPC/Ukrkart ATM-driving disclosures.

coverage_gaps.description: Several candidate root URLs (liqpay.ua, fondy.io, portmone.com.ua, easypay.ua, ipay.ua, visa.com.ua, pumb press centre index) were inferred from search results and operator references rather than opened directly in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Let the deterministic liveness pass resolve exact paths; treat any 403 as bot-defence rather than dead, and re-derive canonical news/press URLs per domain.

coverage_gaps.description: No archival strategy identified for operator KPI pages whose self-reported numbers change silently (RozetkaPay merchant counts, Solidgate client counts).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Register these URLs with a snapshot service and store diffs locally so a defensible time series exists even when the operator overwrites the figure.

coverage_gaps.description: Cross-border/relocation-driven acquiring for Ukrainian merchants (Payoneer, Wise, Paysera, Unlimit, TransferGo) was only touched via the MTO query and not systematically mapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated pass on foreign PSPs/EMIs accredited or actively marketing to Ukrainian merchants, including NBU branch-accreditation records for foreign payment institutions.

coverage_gaps.description: Acquirer/processor-side actors that sit between the schemes and merchants (e.g. UPC — Ukrainian Processing Center, Tas Link, and bank acquiring arms) were not searched in this pass; they publish terminal-fleet and acceptance data relevant to ATM/POS coverage.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated uk/en sweep on 'процесинговий центр', 'УПЦ', 'еквайрингова мережа', 'кількість POS-терміналів' and map processor press rooms.

coverage_gaps.description: Scheme operating rules and Ukraine-specific rule bulletins (Visa Core Rules regional annexes, Mastercard rules) were not located for Ukraine.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search Visa/Mastercard global rules PDFs for Ukraine-specific annexes and country exceptions; these define surcharging, DCC and acceptance obligations.

coverage_gaps.description: PROSTIR transaction-level statistics (volumes/values, not just active-card counts) were not located on prostir.gov.ua itself; only scheme-split card counts via NBU/press.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch prostir.gov.ua sub-pages directly and check NBU statistics files for a PROSTIR volume series; if absent, record as a structural data gap.

coverage_gaps.description: National Cashback / Дія-linked payment programmes involving Mastercard were mentioned in interviews but their official programme pages were not mapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Map diia.gov.ua and Ministry of Economy programme pages for the National Cashback card programme and its scheme partners.

coverage_gaps.description: Cross-border remittance corridors into Ukraine (scheme-based push-to-card, Visa Direct / Mastercard Move) and their NBU-reported volumes were not covered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search 'перекази в Україну', 'Visa Direct Україна', 'Mastercard Move' plus NBU remittance statistics releases.

coverage_gaps.description: No association source found for cash-in-transit, cash-management or ATM-deployment in Ukraine, and ATMIA's Ukrainian membership (if any) was not confirmed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch https://atmia.com/regions/europe/loyal-members and check for Ukrainian entities; in parallel probe for a security-services employers' association (Ukrainian terms: 'асоціація охоронних організацій', 'Федерація професіоналів безпеки України') that might house the CIT segment.

coverage_gaps.description: Both AUB (which exposes an /avtoryzatsiia login) and ATMIA place an unknown share of their statistics behind member authentication. The public/gated boundary was not mapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a deterministic pass that enumerates AUB analytics sub-pages and records HTTP status per URL, so the truly-public statistical series are separated from members-only ones before any collection commitment.

coverage_gaps.description: The UAFIC fintech catalogue itself (PDF or interactive map, 2023/2024/2025 editions) was described in secondary reporting but its direct download URLs were not located, because the association site is JS-rendered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Render fintechua.org with a headless browser and capture the per-year catalogue asset URLs; also check the Ukrainian Startup Fund, Ministry of Digital Transformation and IFC sites for mirrored copies.

coverage_gaps.description: EMA's member register was confirmed to exist and be rich (~80+ organisations) but is rendered as a logo gallery, so a machine-readable member list was not produced in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extract img alt/title attributes and anchor hrefs from https://www.ema.com.ua/about/members/ into a normalised actor table, then reconcile against NABU's bank list and NBU registers.

coverage_gaps.description: Only Kyiv-centric national associations were found; regional banking unions, chambers of commerce (Торгово-промислова палата України) and employer federations (Федерація роботодавців України) were not searched, and they often host banking/payments committees.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a second scouting wave over ТПП України, Федерація роботодавців України and the American Chamber of Commerce in Ukraine, specifically their financial-services and digital-economy committees.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language association coverage was thinner than Ukrainian: only EBA, GB4U and ATMIA were reached in English, and no English-language mirror of NABU/AUB/EMA statistical output was confirmed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Check for /en/ mirrors on nabu.ua, aub.org.ua and ema.com.ua and record whether English versions lag or omit statistics, which determines whether uk-language collection is mandatory for those feeds.

coverage_gaps.description: Payment-scheme and network-adjacent commercial research (Visa/Mastercard commissioned consumer payment studies for Ukraine, and acquirer/processor white papers such as UPC or Ukrainian PSPs) was not searched in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run dedicated queries for 'Visa Україна дослідження платіжних звичок', 'Mastercard дослідження Україна безготівкові', 'UPC аналітика ринку' and check scheme newsroom pages.

coverage_gaps.description: No Russian-language (ru) searching was performed, although a meaningful share of legacy Ukrainian financial-analytics content (including rating agency archives such as standard-rating.biz/rus/) exists in Russian.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a ru-language query pass for archived rating-agency and analytics content, clearly flagged as legacy material.
